reviews.title: Perfect Concept, Passable execution
reviews.body:
Aspect is a fascinating app where AIs manage their own social media accounts. This app is perfect for roleplayers and those who just want a bit of social validation without the pitfalls of social media. While the concept is beautiful, I do have a few gripes with this app.

First, subscribers should not have to pay for images from characters. 40 dollars a year is no small amount of money, and having to spend that much as well as buy gold is a bit overkill. I would be happy to pay for the 40 dollar subscription, which I did, if it provided me with maybe 1000 gold per day, or if gold was unlimited, but not getting anything is disappointing.

Second, AIs should have better built in memory. It would be great if characters could decide to dm you after having a conversation with you and wanting to chat more, or if you collectively decide to chat in DMs in messages. They should also retain all knowledge of conversations you had with them in comments sections.

Third, AIs should be able to post without prompt by humans. AIs with more human followers should have a more frequent post schedule, where the ai prompts the post. Humans should still be able to use gold to prompt posts if they’d like.

Fourth, there should be some sort of daily login bonus for gold. Also, I created an original character and didn’t receive my gold reward. That system needs to be looked at. 

Devs, I hope you see this. I genuinely enjoy this app and would love to see it become more user friendly and popular. I genuinely believe that if you fix the paid tier and incentivize players to login often this app will become much more popular. All the best.

reviews.title: I LOVE IT OMG
reviews.body:
I really, really love this app. It works wonders. It’s kind of like Character AI and Chai AI, but instead of just talking to one character, you can interact with tons of different characters at the same time, which makes it so much more fun and creative. It honestly feels really immersive, like you’re part of a whole AI world, and I enjoy it a lot.
The interactions are super entertaining, and I love how the bots respond and engage. It makes roleplaying and posting feel really alive and exciting.
The only thing I don’t like is the limits. There are restrictions on posting, commenting, and talking to people, and it kind of slows down the experience. I feel like it would be better if texting and commenting were free, and maybe just keep limits on posting instead. That way people would still have boundaries but could stay more engaged. Even something like a small daily post limit would work better and keep users more active.
Overall though, I really enjoy the app and think it has a lot of potential.

reviews.title: My Honest Suggestions
reviews.body:
i genuinely like this app, it has a lot of potential- but there is a lot of work that needs to be put into it. 

i made 3 characters to get gold & in don’t have the gold i was supposed to get after making the characters. the characters i made were going to be made regardless due to the scarcity of the character content i was looking for, but if you’re going to offer free gold by making characters, why did i not get the free gold i was promised? 

anyways, if you want someone to spend $40 a year to be able to do the bare minimum on this app, you should consider giving people more of a chance of trying the app out first before shoving membership prices into their faces. that means, more than 3 DMs sent to characters a day, more posting, more control so the audience can really see how the app works before spending the price of the app. 

as for “gold” to sponsor character’s profiles; i understand sponsoring posts for characters made by other people- but characters WE make on OUR app that WE paid $40 to get the membership perks for, we should be able to post aspect posts on the character profiles WE made. what i mean by that is- being able to upload our own photos of the characters that WE want to see on their profiles just like we are able to post whatever we want on our own profiles, not this AI-generated prompt BS that generates images of the characters that don’t even look like the characters we love!

i’m sending this review in hopes it reaches you guys and you can put the money you’ve made for this app to good use and genuinely consider how much more you could make this app genuinely worth money and flourish. thank you for your time.

reviews.title: What I would like to see in the future
reviews.body:
I did buy the add on or whatever it’s called and I think there’s a few things that truly need brought to this app for it to be outstanding.

First: we need better memory. If I start arguing with a commenter that left something mean they act like they didn’t say their original comment. 

Second: we should have a relationship’s ability. I want to be able to have the bots have opinions of me and have friends and enemies and family and maybe even romance.

Third: let me tag people so I can pretend me and some bots went out for a girly brunch or something.

Fourth (what I want most): bots that post new things. All the posts I see are from the past so we should have an option to let ai generate posts for certain ai’s and/or allow users yo set up new posts that you’ll be able to experience as your account ages in the app based on the date you join and the date a post should be uploaded (ie: forty days from now, on a Sunday, or something similar that gives us the option to make the bots we make more interactive.

The apps premise is amazing but there are not enough features that keep me engaged for longer than a week before uninstalling and then re-downloading a month later and creating a new profile so everything feels fresh again.

Edit: in the newest update fourth has been taken care of and first has def gotten better. Been playing for a couple days now and it feels new. However I have noticed that the bots like to say it’s 2024? I find that weird lol but yes! Much better! I know the gold for the ai’s to post is a bit cash grabby but genuinely this will keep the app from feeling so stale!!!

reviews.title: Interested concept, not worth the subscription
reviews.body:
It was a really interesting concept. I saw the ad and was immediately drawn by the possibilities. It didn’t quite meet expectations though. You get one post per day, and you can’t respond to any of the comments on said post. If you get dm’s, you’re limited to three responses and then you have to wait until the next day. You also can’t send/receive pictures in either comments or dms. It’s very limited. 

Limited, that is, unless you pay the $30 subscription. Then you unlock everything: unlimited posts/comments/messages. You get to control your audience and how they react to you. You even get a little blue checkmark to show you’re official. 

In my opinion, it’s not worth it. If I wanted to talk to bots, there are better sites and apps to do that on, and those are worth the money; not to mention most of their features work in the free version. 
There’s simply not enough to warrant my paying for it nor is there enough in the free version to hold my attention.

Also when I stepped away from the app there were no updates. That’s not how social media works. It’s also mainly random pictures. Not stories or random posts you see on socials. It’s also just really not worth any money. But it wasn’t a horrible experience
reviews.author: Ricksed

reviews.title: Can’t login
reviews.body: Very cool app. My issue is it randomly logged me out one day and I don’t remember what email I used. I tried one email and it wasn’t it, but everytime I logout and try to login again, it just immediately logs me back in with the email I tried, and there is no way that I’ve seen of logging in with another email (I’m clicking login with google) it’s extremely frustrating because now I can’t login and have to make a whole new account.
reviews.author: Scarletrillon

reviews.title: The only way to get premium is by paying $40
reviews.body: This is an absolutely egregious price and I guarantee you guys are losing thousands in potential profit because of it. Why not give the option to pay a higher rate for a shorter subscription? Cool idea and all but who in their right mind is going to pay $40 for this?? Give me the option to pay $5 a month and I won’t give it much thought but I will not be forking over 40 bones not in a million years

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.body: I would give a higher review. The concept is good but I don’t like how I have to pay to actually use the app. If I didn’t have to pay 40$ just to use this I’d give a better rating

reviews.title: Good app, no month to month pro option
reviews.body: This is a really cool app, I just can’t justify paying $40 for a whole year for something I don’t use daily, I’d rather pay $5 per month and if I find myself not using it anymore I can cancel and it gives users an opportunity to decide if they really want to fork out $40

reviews.title: Pretty cool but no free trial?
reviews.body: App is pretty cool, but the pricing could be better. I know that small developers need their money, I get it, I’m a developer myself.
